nodes.label: Mutate BES
nodes.note:
Transform always produces an object output, never a scalar. Each mapping places a value at a target key. The Pipedream code returned a scalar (return overwrite || ...BES), so downstream code reads steps.mutate_bes.$return_value as a number directly.

If this was a Transform with target field value, the output becomes {value: 1234}, and every downstream node that currently reads steps.mutate_bes.$return_value needs to be ported as steps.mutate_bes.output.value (extra path segment).  That's drift in every downstream consumer.
